status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Paper cutout
summary: Layered paper, tactile edges, and a human sense of craft.
use_when: Use for learning stories, workshop invitations, and approachable guides.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Georgia serif headings with system sans-serif body.
layout: Offset paper layers, broad simple shapes, generous margins.
surfaces: Soft paper shadows, slightly uneven borders, earthy cut-paper accents.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Paper cutout to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings with system sans-serif body. Offset paper layers, broad simple shapes, generous margins. Soft paper shadows, slightly uneven borders, earthy cut-paper accents. Palette: background #f4ecd9, surface #fffdf6, text #3e4637, muted #626b56, accent #476b52, border #c0c7af. Essential traits: Layered paper silhouette; Warm natural palette; Handcrafted edge detail. Avoid: Text on busy textures; Excess roughness; Decorations that conceal content. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
